title: Exposure the Hazardous Potential of Quinalphos: An In-Depth Analysis for Environmental and Biological Effects on Human Health.
authors: Choudhari, Jyoti Kant; Sahariah, Biju Prava; Jayapal, Anand Kumar; Choubey, Jyotsna; Tripathi, Abhishek
one_liner_zh: 该文研究农药喹硫磷暴露的毒理效应与基因表达变化，仅涉及转录因子预测和分子对接，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Quinalphos pesticide (QP) exposure can lead to various human health effects, including anaemia, leucocytosis with neutrophilia, hepatic damage and oxidative stress. Acute poisoning symptoms include weakness, sweating, impaired vision and neurological distress. Additionally, neurological and reproductive abnormalities have been reported in specific exposure scenarios. This study identified 16 differentially expressed genes from clinical exposure research. Integrating omics data using network biology approaches has shown that QP significantly alters the expression of 16 genes predicted to be regulated by 26 transcription factors and 41 miRNAs. The molecular docking predicted AR, ESR1, NR1I2, ESR2, CYP19A1 and JUN to have the highest binding affinity with QP. Gene ontology analysis of the DEGs revealed enrichment in pathways related to genital development, oestrogen receptor signalling, prostate gland development and response to vitamin A. The three most influential pathways by these DEGs are detected with significant enrichment in diseases, and they are linked to Cytochrome P450, arranged by substrate type, nuclear receptor transcription pathway and SUMOylation of intracellular receptors. The analysis identified 1445 drugs for 15 genes for potential drug repurposing. The network was pruned by applying the threshold value 0.1 STITCH database and score value 0.1 of the DGIdb database, resulting in the identification of 446 drug (approved and non-approved) therapeutic targets. This analysis provides a comprehensive understanding of the mechanisms of QP-induced toxicity, focusing on humans, and underscores the need for further studies on exposure to QP, providing valuable insights for toxicological risk assessment and regulatory evaluation.
abstract_zh: 喹硫磷农药（QP）暴露可导致多种人体健康影响，包括贫血、中性粒细胞增多的白细胞增多症、肝损伤及氧化应激。急性中毒症状包括虚弱、出汗、视力障碍和神经性不适。此外，在特定暴露场景中已报道神经和生殖异常。本研究从临床暴露研究中鉴定出16个差异表达基因。利用网络生物学方法整合组学数据表明，QP显著改变16个基因的表达，这些基因预计受26个转录因子和41个miRNA调控。分子对接预测AR、ESR1、NR1I2、ESR2、CYP19A1和JUN与QP具有最高结合亲和力。对差异表达基因的基因本体论分析显示，其在生殖器发育、雌激素受体信号传导、前列腺发育和维生素A响应相关通路中富集。这些差异表达基因最具影响力的三条通路在疾病中被检测到显著富集，它们与按底物类型排列的细胞色素P450、核受体转录通路和胞内受体的SUMO化相关。分析为15个基因鉴定出1445种药物，用于潜在的药物再利用。通过应用STITCH数据库阈值0.1和DGIdb数据库评分值0.1对网络进行修剪，最终鉴定出446个药物（已批准和未批准）治疗靶点。该分析提供了对QP诱导毒性机制的全面理解，重点关注人类，并强调了对QP暴露进行进一步研究的必要性，为毒理学风险评估和监管评价提供了宝贵见解。
